contributions.detail: One row, 50.00. Schedule A p2 prints BOTH 'Subtotal for this page $ 50' and 'Total Contributions Received $ 50 (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)'; both equal Box B (Contributions Received This Period, $50) and NOT Box C (Year-to-Date, $10,211.53). The itemised rows are therefore on the PERIOD scope, a different scope from the year-to-date figure. The CFD form has no separate $50-or-less aggregate line, so the le50 anchors are null.

expenditures.detail: Schedule B p3 carries no inked lines; the filer wrote 0 in both 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Expenditures Made', which equals Box D (Expenditures Made This Period $0) and not Box E (Year-to-Date $8,830.17). Empty schedule = a real zero on the period scope, not a gap.

gates.page_subtotal: p2 rows sum 50.00 = printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 50' = printed 'Total Contributions Received $ 50'. p3 zero rows = printed subtotal 0 = printed total 0. Both gate exactly.
gates.row_count: p2: ~15 printed underline bands, exactly 1 carries ink (counted by an independent per-column ink-profile scan of the amount column x72-92%, which returned one value band at y18.2-19.3% above the first rule, and nothing else down to the subtotal block). p3: 0 inked bands. rowbands.py not needed - the ink profile is the independent count.
gates.geometry_proof: p2 first(=only)-row amount crop pct:75.96,19.00,16.00,2.20 at 600 dpi renders '$50'; the SAME box one row-pitch (4.35%) higher renders the printed 'Amount' column header (the page is skewed, so the header sits lower on the right than on the left - the reason the first naive band was wrong); the box one pitch BELOW the row renders empty.
gates.balance_chain: Box A 2,087.20 + Box B 50 = Box F 2,137.20 (closes exactly); Box F 2,137.20 - Box D 0 = Balance at Close 2,137.20 (closes exactly). The filer annotates both A, F and the close as '(minus in-kind)' / '(minus $2,137.20 of in-kind on prior report)' - kept verbatim in the anchors. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so the cross-filing cumulative chain was not run here.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops: (1) full row-1 band, (2) amount cell of row 1, (3) control cell one pitch below. No digit was in doubt; the escalations were the geometry proof and a re-read of the one amount.
